derivation.about: Spec for SendingAnalysis (Swift) / SendingAnalysis.kt and ToneKeyingDetector on both ports. Inputs are key-down/key-up schedules built from the 1:3 / 1:3:7 standard; every expected value below was worked by hand from these rules, not captured from either port.
derivation.cleanup: Sort marks by down time; drop marks with up <= down. Merge a mark into the previous one when the gap between them is under glitchMs (5 ms); then drop marks shorter than glitchMs.
derivation.classify: Durations d. If max/min < 1.8, every mark is one kind: dah when d >= 2 * (1200 / characterWpm), else dit. Otherwise two-means on ln(d): centres start at ln(min) and ln(max); a mark is a dah when ln(d) >= the centres' midpoint; recompute centres as the mean ln of each class; repeat until no mark changes class (at most 20 rounds). If exp(dahCentre - ditCentre) < 1.8 at the end, fall back to the one-kind rule.
derivation.unit: unit = mean dit duration (ms); mean dah / 3 when there are no dits.
derivation.farnsworth: k = spacingUnit / unit of MorseTiming(characterWpm, effectiveWpm) (the ARRL formula already in fixtures/timing.json); k = 1 without Farnsworth.
derivation.gaps: gap = next down - this up. gap / unit < 2 is inside a character (element gap, reported in units). Otherwise spacing = gap / (unit * k): < 5 ends a character (character gap), >= 5 ends a word (word gap). Character and word gaps are reported in these spacing units.
derivation.decode: Each character's dits and dahs ('.'/'-') look up MorseCode; an unknown pattern reads as '#'. Words joined by one space.
derivation.speed: characterWpm = 1200 / unit. effectiveWpm = 1200 * U / (last up - first down), where U is the standard length of what was sent: 1 per dit, 3 per dah, 1 per element gap, 3 per character gap, 7 per word gap (no trailing gap).
derivation.target: Uppercase; any whitespace run becomes one space; characters with no Morse pattern are dropped; trimmed.
derivation.alignment: Levenshtein over target and decoded text, spaces included as tokens. Match 0, substitution 1, missing (target token not sent) 1, extra (sent token not in target) 1; a space never substitutes for a character. Backtrace from the end preferring diagonal, then missing, then extra. Codes: '=X' match, '~XY' X sent as Y, '-X' missing (space = a word break sent too short), '+Y' extra (space = a word split). accuracy = matched non-space target characters / non-space target characters.
derivation.feedback: Checked in this order; a code appears when its rule holds. slowerThanTarget: key type is not keyer, marks >= 5 and characterWpm < 0.85 * target. fasterThanTarget: key type is not keyer, marks >= 5 and characterWpm > 1.15 * target. dahsShort / dahsLong: key type is not keyer, dits >= 3 and dahs >= 3, mean dah / mean dit < 2.5 / > 3.5. ditsUneven: straight or cootie, dits >= 5, sd/mean > 0.25 (population sd). dahsUneven: not keyer, dahs >= 5, sd/mean > 0.25. elementGapsShort / Long: not keyer, element gaps >= 3, mean < 0.7 / > 1.5. charGapsShort / Long: character gaps >= 3, mean < 2.5 / > 4.0. charGapsUneven: character gaps >= 5, sd/mean > 0.3. wordGapsShort / Long: word gaps >= 2, mean < 6 / > 9. wordsRunTogether: a missing space. wordsSplit: an extra space. perfectCopy: every alignment step a match. timingOnTarget: marks >= 5 and none of the codes before wordsRunTogether.
derivation.record: SendingRecord.record: every non-space target token is an attempt at that character, missed unless matched. Inside each target word, every adjacent pair is an attempt at the pair, missed unless both halves matched. A substitution whose sent character is not '#' adds a mix-up target->sent. problemCharacters/problemPairs: attempts >= minAttempts and misses > 0, worst miss rate first, then most misses, then key order.

derivation.blocks: blockSamples = max(16, round(sampleRate * 0.004)). Per block, Goertzel magnitude 2*sqrt(s1^2 + s2^2 - c*s1*s2)/N (sine amplitude) at 300..1200 Hz in 50 Hz steps (or the locked / manual pitch only); level = the largest.
derivation.tracking: First block seeds floor and peak. While up: floor += (level - floor) * (0.5 if level < floor else 0.002). While down: peak = max(peak, level). Every block: peak = max(floor, peak - (peak - floor) * 0.003).
derivation.thresholds: on when level > max(floor*snr, 0.002, floor + 0.5*(peak-floor)); stays on while level >= max(floor*snr*0.7, 0.0015, floor + 0.35*(peak-floor)). snr = 4.
derivation.debounce: A change must hold two consecutive blocks; the edge is stamped at the start of the first (block index * blockSamples / sampleRate). On confirming a key-down, peak = max(peak, level).
derivation.pitch: While unlocked, each block with the key down votes for its loudest candidate; the first to 12 votes is locked.
derivation.signal: Test signal: amplitude * sin(2*pi*pitch*n/rate) during each mark (n the absolute sample index), plus noise: x = (1103515245*x + 12345) mod 2^31 from seed 1, sample += (x / 2^31 * 2 - 1) * noiseAmplitude, and a single-sample impulse of +impulseAmplitude at each listed time.
